pr_title: Address `Selenium [DEPRECATION] [:browser_options] :options as a parameter for driver initialization is deprecated.`
pr_body:
### Summary

This commit addresses the deprecation warning since https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/pull/7832 is available as `selenium-webdriver` 4.0.0.

- Deprecation warning addressed

```ruby
WARN Selenium [DEPRECATION] [:browser_options] :options as a parameter for driver initialization is deprecated. Use :capabilities with an Array of value capabilities/options if necessary instead.
```

- Steps to reproduce (if you have sample app with system tests, you can use it)

```ruby
git clone https://github.com/yahonda/rep43493
cd rep43493
bundle install
bin/rails test:system
```

Please ignore `4 runs, 1 assertions, 0 failures, 3 errors, 0 skips` since I have not implemented any tests.
Just wanted to see if the deprecation is removed or not.

- Without this commit

```ruby
% bin/rails test:system
Run options: --seed 61164

# Running:

DEBUGGER: Detaching after fork from parent process 96379
DEBUGGER: Attaching after process 96379 fork to child process 96398
2021-10-20 12:14:40 WARN Selenium [DEPRECATION] [:browser_options] :options as a parameter for driver initialization is deprecated. Use :capabilities with an Array of value capabilities/options if necessary instead.
Capybara starting Puma...
* Version 5.5.2 , codename: Zawgyi
* Min threads: 0, max threads: 4

...
```

- With this commit

issue_context.title: Deprecation warnings with selenium-webdriver 4.x
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce

Use `driven_by :selenium` in a system test with version 4.x of selenium-webdriver.

### Expected behavior

No deprecation warning is issued.

### Actual behavior

A deprecation warning is issued:

```
WARN Selenium [DEPRECATION] [:browser_options] :options as a parameter for driver initialization is deprecated. Use :capabilities with an Array of value capabilities/options if necessary instead
```

### System configuration
**Rails version**: 6.1.4.1

**Ruby version**: 3.0.2p107
comments:
For context, this is the [selenium PR](https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/pull/7832) that introduced the deprecation and new implementation.

The options parameter is used in action_dispatch.

https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/5b33d467055c825e88f946d5bca234d678c279e7/actionpack/lib/action_dispatch/system_testing/driver.rb#L58
Opened #43496 to remove this warning in Rails system tests.

review_comments:
Are we sure this will work once the previous selenium implementation is no longer supported?

My understanding based on [this PR](https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/pull/7832) was that we would also need to change what value we assign to `capabilities`.

```
# old:
driver = Selenium::WebDriver.for :chrome, {desired_capabilities: caps, options: opts}
# new:
driver = Selenium::WebDriver.for :chrome, {capabilities: [caps, opts]}
```

New Rails 7.0 generator produces a Gemfile with "selenium-webdriver", ">= 4.0.0" to support Ruby 3.0 (#43270),
so I'll drop selenium-webdriver 3.x support for Rails 7.0 in #43498.

@cpjmcquillan It should work with the newest selenium-webdriver (4.0.3), since it'll convert capabilities to an array if it's not already an array ([ref](https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/blob/trunk/rb/lib/selenium/webdriver/common/driver.rb#L314)):
```
caps = opts.delete(:capabilities)
# NOTE: This is deprecated
cap_array = caps.is_a?(Hash) ? [caps] : Array(caps)
```

But that line is marked as deprecated, so I'm not sure how long it's gonna be in there.
In case it's removed, the behavior is unknown.
